model: free-edge triangular finite-element membrane on N=127 contact; same corrected 2H MoSSe local GSFE; COM translation and infinitesimal rigid rotation removed from internal displacements

nominal_elastic_constants.source: S.-D. Guo, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 20, 7236-7242 (2018), DOI 10.1039/C8CP00350E

caveat: Tier-1 in-plane linear-elastic sensitivity validation only; no out-of-plane relaxation, atomistic edge reconstruction, defects, nonlocal edge energy, load-dependent GSFE, or dissipative parameter calibration.
